## 1. PERFORMANCE SUMMARY

Yesterday's fleet RT average of **$36.26/MWh** continues the three-day deceleration from **$57.76 → $50.18 → $37.44 → $36.26**, signaling a sustained softening of real-time prices as wind (11.6 GW) and solar (9.6 GW) generation provided ample supply against mild late-October demand. The absence of spike nodes (>$100/MWh) and negative price nodes marks the cleanest, most benign RT environment the fleet has seen this week — a sharp contrast to the 10-11 spike nodes seen Monday and Tuesday. The standout story is **PAVLOV_BT_RN**, which posted a **DA premium of $54.96/MWh over RT** — the single largest positive DART in the fleet — driven by the BLESSI_PAVLOV1_1 constraint delivering a **+$76.03/MWh MCC benefit**, an extraordinary congestion windfall for any asset that held DA commitments at that node. **Today (10/31):** Mild temperatures across ERCOT — Austin 82°F/65°F, DFW 76°F/65°F, Houston 83°F/69°F — with no meaningful heating or cooling demand catalyst.
